name: JG_FSCL_LINES_ATRB_INT
description: This interface table contains additional transaction line level attributes required for fiscal document. This table would be used with Fiscal Document Capture and Receivables applications to receive additional attributes for interfaced transactions.

columns.name: INTERFACE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Interface line identifier corresponding to the transaction line during import of transactions.

columns.name: INTERFACE_HDR_ID
columns.description: Interface header identifier of the document.

columns.name: APP_SHORT_NAME
columns.description: Application short name of the transaction.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier on a transaction.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier of a transaction line.

columns.name: TRX_LEVEL_TYPE
columns.description: Level at which the transaction line identifier is stored. Possible values are LINE, SHIPMENT and FREIGHT.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BU_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the name of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: SOURCE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: The identifier for a shipment transaction used to identify the transaction number associated to a shipment line.

columns.name: TRX_LINE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Shows the description of the National Service Fiscal Document transaction line. Default values is the description of the first transaction line by the Request Fiscal Document Process.

columns.name: PREV_FISCAL_DOC_SRC_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies if the source that generated the previous fiscal document is Cloud ERP or an external system.

columns.name: PREV_FISCAL_DOC_KEY
columns.description: Communication service fiscal document key of an approved fiscal document used as a reference for an adjustment.

columns.name: PREV_FISCAL_DOC_LINE_NUM
columns.description: Communication Service Fiscal Document line number of an approved fiscal document that will be reference for an adjustment.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PO_NUMBER
columns.description: The purchase order number provided by the customer to identify the corresponding transaction in the procure-to-pay flow.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PO_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: The line number from the customer's purchase order used to identify the corresponding transaction line in the procure-to-pay flow.
